svg.title: How the matcher follows speech
svg.desc: Animation generated from the real matcher. Words heard so far appear as chips. Interim words move a dashed tentative cursor through the script; a final result moves the solid confirmed cursor and dims the spoken words. The filler "uh" is ignored, "twenty three" matches "twenty-three", and after a skipped sentence the cursor waits for five matching words before catching up.
svg.text: Interim words move the tentative cursor. “uh” is ignored.
A final result confirms them. Confirmed never moves back.
A skipped sentence: the cursor waits for proof…
…five matching words, then it catches up.
